methodology: Five alternating samples after one warmup per version; Red 0.2.7, SQLite in memory, no concurrent tests. School includes startup, schema and tracing. Command workload times execution of 100 persisted commands, excluding setup and submission, with tracing disabled. Both versions use equivalent isolated source snapshots (lib, examples and identical META6.json), each with its own warmed precompilation cache.
